feature: Structural fix for select-only performance is deferred to M0092. The initial audit is complete but the implementation is left for the next milestone.
The needsVacuum function always returns true when RowCount > 0 and does not respect autovacuum reloptions like autovacuum_enabled = off
DEFAULT clause in column definitions is skipped during parsing; default values are not stored or applied to new rows
Window function queries are excluded from processing and not executed.
DROP for sequence/schema/type objects is not fully implemented; only IF EXISTS NOTICE behavior is handled.
WITH OPTIONS clause in column definitions implemented as no-op; column-level options are not processed or applied
Subscriber setup with streaming and logical replication for replicating changes is not implemented in goopg v0.
min_parallel_table_scan_size and min_parallel_index_scan_size GUCs are accepted but not acted upon; query planner ignores these settings.
goopg does not emit a blank data row for 0-column SELECT results; PostgreSQL outputs one that goopg omits.
evictMu lock serializes MarkDirty and WAL operations; should allow concurrent execution for better write performance.
WAL commit-delay sleep path is disabled due to race condition where stale values are written back; actual fix deferred.
pg_relation_size, pg_total_relation_size, pg_indexes_size, and pg_table_size are stubbed; do not return actual relation sizes.
